COE_RCT_IND_OVERALL_RJ.note: Page 1 title says 'STAMPEDE randomised trial' and the page 3 keywords print 'phase III' and 'randomised controlled trial'; page 4 describes central 1:1 randomisation.

Class of Agent in Treatment Arm 1.note: Pages 3-4 give the add-on as abiraterone acetate 1000 mg + prednisolone 5 mg added to lifelong ADT (SOC); abiraterone is an androgen synthesis inhibitor and prednisolone is its companion steroid, so the table treats AAP as a single add-on class (doublet), as the Type of Therapy rule does.

Volume of disease - N (%) | High | Treat.note: Page 5 Table 1, 'Metastatic disease risk group' (LATITUDE definition, page 4), prints High-risk SOC + AAP (n = 501): 241 (48%); the definition names LATITUDE criteria and the paper gives no CHAARTED volume split, so this is the high-volume/burden split.

Volume of disease - N (%) | High | Contr.note: Page 5 Table 1, 'Metastatic disease risk group', prints High-risk SOC-alone (n = 502): 232 (46%); LATITUDE risk is the paper's only disease-burden split (page 4 definition: at least two of >=3 bone metastases, visceral metastases, Gleason >=8).

Volume of disease - N (%) | Low | Contro.note: Page 5 Table 1, 'Metastatic disease risk group', prints Low-risk SOC-alone (n = 502): 220 (44%).

Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N | H.note: Page 8 Table 3 gives OS, FFS, PFS, MPFS, SRE and DSS for the LATITUDE High-risk group (SOC-alone n = 232, SOC + AAP n = 241) and page 9 Figure 3A plots OS for the high-risk group; the paper frames this split as disease burden (page 9).

Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N | L.note: Page 8 Table 3 gives all outcomes for the LATITUDE Low-risk group (SOC-alone n = 220, SOC + AAP n = 208) and page 9 Figure 3B plots OS for the low-risk group.

Median OS (mo) | Overall | Treatment.note: Page 6 prints 'Median survival was ... 79 months (IQR 33, not reached) in the SOC + AAP group'; 'not reached' is the upper IQR bound, not the median.
